name: Research
tagline: Find information in your source material, extract data, and prepare cited summaries for review.

useCases.title: Literature screening
useCases.description: Triage a stack of papers against your inclusion criteria, summarizing each and flagging the ones worth a full read.

useCases.title: Data extraction
useCases.description: Pull methods, sample sizes, and results from papers into a structured table for a review or meta-analysis.

useCases.title: Library questions
useCases.description: Ask questions across your reference library and get answers that cite the specific paper and section.

useCases.title: Analysis pipelines
useCases.description: Build a workflow that loads data, runs your analysis tools, and summarizes the results.

useCases.title: Manuscript drafting
useCases.description: Draft related-work sections, abstracts, and figure captions from your notes and cited sources for your edit.

useCases.title: Grant and proposal support
useCases.description: Draft specific-aims and background sections based on your prior work and the literature, for your revision.

faq.q: Will answers be traceable to sources?
faq.a: Yes. Add your papers and datasets to a Space. Every answer cites the source so you can verify it before it enters a manuscript or report.

Yes. With a local model, unpublished results and datasets stay on your machine. For cloud models, Gateway rules can block or redact personal data and log each call. Analytics and crash reports are on by default and can be turned off.

faq.q: Can I reproduce an analysis later?
faq.a: Yes. Capture the steps as a Workflow that chains tools and agents, then rerun it on new inputs or schedule it. Workflow history shows each run, and the Gateway audit trail records the model calls it routed.
